title: Finite Q3 split-history Volterra carrier with both cubic-multiplier orientations
question: For the declared finite Q3 split dynamics, can both noncommuting cubic-multiplier orientations be propagated through an explicit Volterra history with finite operator and Gibbs-state controls, without silently replacing the split evolution by an unsplit exponential?
method: Use the hash-pinned finite Q3 edge, square and 2x3 graph fixture from EXP-001158 with oscillator dimension three, source pair [0,1], probe sites, and beta values copied into the manifest.

Construct the weighted positive energy proxy and the two products f_x^(3/4) q_x^3 A_f^(-3/4) and f_x^(3/4) A_f^(-3/4) q_x^3 separately, then propagate each product and their difference by V_N(M)=delta sum_{k=0}^{N-1} Ad(U^k)(M) for delta=1/18 and N in {1,3,6}.

Run both onsite-then-lexicographic-bonds and reverse-term split orders with both time signs, check unitary errors, the history difference identity, operator triangles, finite telescoping bounds, and normalized full-Hamiltonian Gibbs four-leg envelopes on all 96 declared history rows.
Recompute the same finite grid independently by diagonalizing each split term once, and compile Lean R330 for the exact rational time-horizon, difference, triangle, and scope bookkeeping.
finding: Primary 1402/1402 and independent 1304/1304 assertions pass on the complete 96-row grid (volumes 2, 4, 6; eight probe/order/sign combinations per declared time count). The integrated verifier passes 14/14 and Lean R330 compiles. Primary and independent maxima agree within approximately 3e-15: right operator norm 0.607485470838267, left operator norm 0.6074854708382673, commutator-history operator norm 0.14231441030898842, and Gibbs four-leg norm 1.1419245640005118. Every declared row satisfies the nonzero orientation floor, Volterra difference identity, operator triangle, finite telescoping bound, and Gibbs-state triangle/envelope checks.
decision_reason: The finite split evolution now carries both noncommuting multiplier orientations through an explicit discrete Volterra history for both orderings and time signs. This closes a reusable finite carrier and finite telescoping firewall, but it does not provide an analytic infinite-dimensional Volterra estimate or any source/volume/beta-uniform control; the QFT construction therefore remains open.
boundary: Finite oscillator-dimension-three matrices on the declared edge, square and 2x3 graphs, finite split orders, time signs, step counts and Gibbs probes only; no common-core operator-domain embedding, actual Q3 dynamics identification, direct D/delta-D Cauchy estimate, uniformity, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion.
next_action: Use the two-orientation split history as the carrier for an analytic source/beta/volume-uniform Volterra or direct D/delta-D Cauchy estimate. If the required constants or domains fail, register only that precise route-local obstruction and keep common-alpha and QFT reconstruction open.
no_overclaim: This finite split-history audit validates discrete matrix bookkeeping and preserves both operator orientations. It neither proves an infinite-dimensional Volterra estimate nor establishes OS/KMS/GNS dynamics, a mass gap, a continuum limit, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.
open: analytic Volterra estimate with source and volume control
source/beta/volume-uniform direct D and delta-D Cauchy

adversarial_review.check: Each history is built from onsite-plus-bond unitary factors in both declared term orders and both time signs; no unsplit exponential is substituted.
Right and left cubic multiplier products are propagated separately and their difference is propagated as its own history.
The discrete history identity and finite telescoping bounds are checked row by row and also represented by exact rational Lean lemmas.
The four-leg norms use the normalized full-Hamiltonian Gibbs square root at each beta; split invariance of the Gibbs state is not assumed.
Volumes, probes, beta values and time windows are a declared finite grid; extrema and agreement are diagnostics, not asymptotic or uniform estimates.
No common core, analytic history bound, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion is drawn.

qft_interface.closed: A finite split-history carrier with explicit right/left cubic-multiplier orientations, orientation-difference identity, finite operator/Gibbs bounds, and Lean bookkeeping is recorded.
qft_interface.open: The analytic infinite-dimensional Volterra estimate, operator domains, actual Q3 history, source/volume/beta uniformity, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Auxiliary C6 evidence only; no TECT production owner, heat_root_incidence, physical-empty reference or Sector-A closure is supplied.
